senses.gloss: m., קָשָׁה f. (b. h.; preced.) stiff, hard, difficult, severe; strong.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 9:2">Tosef. Sabb. IX</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 10:2">X</cite>), 2 <he>שני זייפין מן הק׳ וכ׳</he> (some ed. <he>הקַשׁ</he>) two of the stiffest bristles of the swine; <cite ref="Shabbat 90b:3">Sabb. 90ᵇ</cite> <he>מקָשָׁה של חזיר אחת</he> carrying one of the stiff bristles of the swine is punishable.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 88b:6">B. Bath. 88ᵇ</cite> <he>ק׳ עונשן של וכ׳</he> the responsibility for fraud in measures is severer than that for incest.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 88b:9">Ib.</cite> <he>ק׳ גזל הדיוט וכ׳</he> robbing an individual is worse than robbing the altar.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 26:7">Gen. R. s. 26</cite>, end <he>ק׳ היא המחלוקת וכ׳</he> strife is as bad as (the sins of) the generation of the flood.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 71:2">Gen. R. s. 71</cite> <he>ק׳ היא התפלה וכ׳</he> prayer is a powerful factor, for it reversed the divine decree.
<cite ref="Taanit 8a:4">Taan. 8ᵃ</cite> <he>שלמודו ק׳ עליו וכ׳</he> to whom his study is as hard as iron.
<cite ref="Taanit 8b:11">Ib. 8ᵇ</cite> (in Chald. dict.) <he>ק׳ יומא וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="S02238"><he>קָשֵׁי</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 6:5">Ex. R. s. 6</cite> <he>היה ק׳ בעיניהם וכ׳</he> it seemed too hard a task for them to give up idolatry; a. v. fr.—

<cite ref="Eruvin 83b">Erub. 83ᵇ</cite> <he>בק׳</he> with difficulty, v. <cite ref="N00532"><he>נַחַת</he></cite>.—[<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 16:25">Num. R. s. 16</cite> end <he>קשה ערפם</he>, v. <cite ref="S02237"><he>קְשִׁי</he></cite>.]—Pl. <he>קָשִׁים</he>, <he>קָשִׁין</he>; <cite ref="S02227"><he>קָשׁוֹת</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Yevamot 47b:5">Yeb. 47ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>ק׳ גרים וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="O01345"><he>סַפַּחַת</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Pesachim 118a:11">Pes. 118ᵃ</cite> <he>ק׳ … כקריעת וכ׳</he> the providential support of man is as difficult (wonderful) as the splitting of the Red Sea.
<cite ref="Pesachim 118a:6">Ib.</cite> <he>ק׳ … כפלים וכ׳</he> man’s support is twice as hard (painful) as travailing.
<cite ref="Berakhot 57b:17">Ber. 57ᵇ</cite> (etymolog. play on <cite ref="S01209"><he>קישואים</he></cite>) <he>מפני שהם ק׳ לגוף וכ׳</he> because they are as hard on the body as swords.
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 12:7:1">Koh. R. to XII, 7</cite> <he>נבואות ק׳</he> hard (evil) prophecies; a. v. fr.
